description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class GatewayQueryTimeExceededException, which indicates that an HTTP query has timed out on the backend. The class extends DittoRuntimeException and implements GatewayException, providing various constructors, static factory methods, and a builder class for creating instances with specific details. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.base.exceptions package.
